English.Char_Desc_2000:
Cerchen v3 is a multi-engine search tool for Windows from Transys. Instead of opening three browser windows and typing the same query again and again, you type it once in Cerchen and press Search (or Enter).
Your query goes to Google, Yahoo and Bing. Each search engine has its own tab, and each tab shows that engine's real results page for your query. Click a tab to switch engines and compare the results, spot sources that only one engine finds, and get a broader view of any topic. This makes Cerchen useful for students, researchers, writers and anyone who wants more than one opinion on a search.
Features: - One search box and one Search button for Google, Yahoo and Bing - A separate tab for each search engine - Each tab opens its engine's home page at startup and remembers the page you were on - Links that try to open new windows stay inside the same tab - Modern page display using the Microsoft Edge WebView2 engine - Single small executable: no installation, no setup, just run it - Sharp display on high-DPI screens
System requirements: Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit), the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime (already included in Windows 10 and 11; Cerchen shows a download link if it is missing), and an internet connection. Cerchen is developed by Transys, Karachi, Pakistan. CEO/VP Faiz ul Haque Zeya.
